attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is enumerated — thirteen men named in the day's own line and again in the page's thirteen head lines, each «Οσιομάρτυρας Και Ομολογητης Της Μονης Κανταρας Κυπρου (; - 1231)» — so it is thirteen folders and not one, by docs/CORPUS.md §10.1. Nothing in the corpus answers to any of them: no folder mentions Kantara, and none of the corpus's men of these names is a thirteenth-century Cypriot. The page gives the thirteen one shared narrative, one death date, and no hymn; the life here is that shared narrative with a closing sentence for each man. His own head line reads «Αγιος Κονων Οσιομαρτυρας Και Ομολογητης Της Μονης Κανταρας Κυπρου (; - 1231)».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
